snippet.title: Saints Row (2006) Rumbler
snippet.description:
The Rumbler is a vehicle in The Gankster Pack DLC for Saints Row.

The Rumbler can only be obtained if The Gankster Pack is downloaded from the Xbox 360 Marketplace for 400 MS Points. It is available at Foreign Power, and costs $1 to buy. If Foreign Power has a temporary discount, the Rumbler is free.
